description: Validates that HTTP endpoints implement rate limiting

rules.title: Rate limiting on HTTP endpoints
rules.description: All public HTTP endpoints MUST implement rate limiting to prevent denial-of-service attacks. Use configurable window and limit values from environment variables.
rules.validationQuery: Rate limiting configured with configurable env vars

rules.title: Request body size limits
rules.description: All HTTP services MUST enforce a maximum request body size to prevent memory exhaustion attacks.
rules.validationQuery: Body size limit configured via MCP_MAX_BODY_BYTES or equivalent

rules.title: HTTP server timeouts
rules.description: HTTP servers SHOULD configure request timeouts and keep-alive timeouts to prevent connection exhaustion (slowloris).
